data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, independently of others—an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each switch from 10 to 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. All other 24 fishers: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher22/07/18/01, help recruit.
